name: paper-tear
title: Paper Tear
description: The outgoing scene is printed on paper that strains, rips down the middle with a jolt of the camera and a flash, and is flung apart in two torn halves with flying scraps, revealing the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ptr-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A violent, physical scene change: a reveal, a breakthrough, a big announcement.
Scenes that already feel printed or poster-like.
avoidWhen: Calm or elegant pieces where an impact would feel out of place.
Scenes with important content on the seam in the middle.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Impact
variables.description: Strength of the shake, flash and debris. 0 turns them off.

variables.label: Roughness
variables.description: How jagged the rip is, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Seed for the shape of the rip.

variables.label: Edge color
variables.description: Color of the fibrous torn edge.

variables.label: Shadow color
variables.description: CSS color of the shadow the torn halves cast.
